results.previous_best: O(t^2) CoT tokens via Turing-machine-based CoT simulation
results.quote: Let M be a flat Word RAM program with word size w. Then there exists a rightmost UHAT T with finite precision, O(w) heads each of width O(w), and total model dimension O(w^2)=O(log^2(n+t)), such that, for any t≥n, T can simulate t steps of M with t·O(w^2) CoT steps. Further, if M does not use ×, ÷, or mod, T can simulate t steps of M with t·O(w) CoT steps.
